name: handsets
description: Control Android devices and emulators: read the screen, tap, type, swipe and wait, over adb.
long_description: Runs the `hs` CLI as a stdio MCP server (`hs mcp`); the bundle carries `hs` and its on-device daemon. Start with the `use` tool, then read the screen with `ui` or `screenshot` and act with `tap`, `type`, `fill`, `swipe` and `go`. adb is found through Google's Android CLI (`android info`), ANDROID_HOME, PATH or Android Studio's default SDK; set ADB path below to override.

adb_path.title: ADB path
adb_path.description: Optional. Path to the adb executable, if it isn't found automatically.

tools.name: use
tools.description: Connect to a device and start the on-device daemon. Call this first.

tools.name: ui
tools.description: List what is on screen: tappable nodes with text, #resource-id and centre x,y.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the screen as a JPEG image.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find nodes matching a selector without acting.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap a node by text / #resource_id / selector, or tap x,y.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into the focused field.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Set the text of an edit field in one step.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe up, down, left or right.

tools.name: go
tools.description: Press back, home, recents, enter or another key.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait until text or a selector appears.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Launch an app by package, activity or label.

tools.name: logcat
tools.description: Recent device log lines, filtered by app, priority, tag or pattern.

tools.name: hs
tools.description: Run any other hs CLI verb.
